config.name: training-step-v1
config.note: Placeholder sizes around the planned 9M to 13M parameters: one below the range, three inside it and one above. Feedforward width is four times d_model.

definitions.step: One step is zeroing gradients, the forward pass, the loss, the backward pass and the optimiser update, on a batch already on the device. On the Apple GPU path the clock stops only after the device has finished its queued work.
definitions.peak_memory: process_peak_footprint_bytes is the lifetime peak of the process's physical footprint as macOS accounts it (proc_pid_rusage), read after the timed steps. It includes the Python interpreter, PyTorch and, on Apple silicon, memory held for the GPU. Each case runs in its own process.

not_measured: the render loss and the training renderer (S3)
the minimum-cost assignment of structural slots inside the structure loss
loading and batching real dataset records
whether the model learns anything: inputs and targets are random numbers

conditions.statement: Every case ran on AC power with Low Power Mode off.

apple_gpu_path.statement: No unsupported operation and no CPU fallback: all 15 Apple GPU cases ran with the fallback switch off, where an unsupported operation stops the step, and PyTorch's MPS profiler logged no CPU fallback.
apple_gpu_path.method: Timed cases run with PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK unset, so an operation PyTorch has not implemented for the Apple GPU path raises and is named. One further untimed run per size allows the fallback and turns on PyTorch's MPS profiler (PYTORCH_MPS_LOG_PROFILE_INFO), which logs each CPU fallback and counts copies between CPU and GPU memory. This covers the operations of the placeholder step only; the training renderer's operations are checked in S3.

rule.text: Eligible: ran on the Apple GPU path at the reference batch size with no CPU fallback, peak footprint inside the memory budget, one reference epoch inside the time budget. Chosen: the eligible size inside the planned range nearest its middle; failing that, the largest eligible size below the range.

selection.statement: d384-l6 (10.73M parameters) is the eligible size nearest the middle of the planned range. Neither memory nor time was the limit for it at batch 64.

projections.label: projection
projections.basis: Each duration is the number of steps multiplied by the median measured step of the placeholder on the Apple GPU path. The epoch counts are assumptions for scale, not estimates of how long training takes to converge; no figure from a paper is used.
projections.covers: one structure-only run; the structure-plus-render arm cannot be projected until S3
